fiction_label: FICTIONAL SIMULATION — Redhawk Forge and Bayline Kings are invented teams; no real league, club, broadcaster, or player names, marks, logos, uniforms, or likenesses.

beats.title: One play left
beats.camera: high wide over the stadium, slow push toward the line of scrimmage; night lights, breath vapor
captions: Thirty-five to thirty-two. Fourth and fourteen. Four seconds. One play.

beats.title: The huddle and the snap
beats.camera: low behind the offense, handheld shake; line set, receivers wide
captions: Everybody deep. Protect, then throw it as far as it will go.

beats.title: The throw
beats.camera: track the ball: snap, step-up, launch; arc follow shot as the clock dies under it

scoreboard.clock: 0:04 → 0:00 (dies while the ball is in the air)

captions: Takes the snap... steps up... and launches it toward the goal line—

beats.title: The catch at zero
beats.camera: end-zone reverse angle, 40% slow motion: tip, hands, turf, official's arms up

scoreboard.note: insert flips from 35-32 to 38-35 exactly at the catch

captions: TIPPED... CAUGHT! IN THE END ZONE! AT ZERO! TOUCHDOWN FORGE!

beats.title: The roar
beats.camera: handheld field rush: bench empties, helmets flying, confetti guns
captions: The try is waived — it cannot change the winner. Redhawk Forge wins it, thirty-eight to thirty-five!

beats.title: Closing card
beats.camera: static card, slow vignette close; fiction label legible for the full beat
